heading: Personal access tokens
description: Tokens let scripts and other programs use the Leafdesk REST API as you, with your access to pages. Keep them secret, like a password.

created.title: Copy your new token
created.body: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it somewhere safe; if you lose it, revoke it and create another.

revokeError: Could not revoke the token. Try again.

errors.name: Give the token a name of at most 100 characters.
errors.scopes: Choose what the token may do.
errors.workspace: You are not a member of that workspace.
errors.limit: You have the most tokens allowed. Revoke one first.
errors.generic: Could not create the token. Try again.
errors.ownerScope: Only a workspace's owners can let a token read its audit log, and only a token limited to that workspace.

docsPage.tokensWhere: Create a token under My account → Connected apps.
docsPage.name: Name

pages.name: Pages
pages.hint: Pages, sub-pages and daily notes; writing also covers voice notes.

rows.name: Rows
rows.hint: Query rows and read their activity; writing adds and changes rows.

comments.name: Comments
comments.hint: Comment threads; writing starts threads and replies.

agents.name: Agents
agents.hint: Agents' settings, runs, schedules and sharing.

webhooks.name: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: Page webhooks and their deliveries; writing adds, changes and tests them (owners only).

audit.name: Audit log
audit.hint: The workspace's audit log (owners only, for a token limited to a workspace they own).

edit.title: Change what {name} may do
edit.body: The token keeps its secret; the change applies from its next request.
edit.legacy: This token was made before access was chosen per resource, so it can read everything (and write everything, if it was made for writing), including what is added later. Saving gives it exactly what you choose here.

errors.scopes: Choose at least one thing the token may do.
errors.generic: Could not change the token. Try again.
errors.ownerScope: Only a workspace's owners can let a token read its audit log, and only a token limited to that workspace.
